newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turkish troops kill Maoist rebel leader.
newsitem.headline: Turkish troops kill Maoist rebel leader.

text.p: Turkish troops have killed the leader of a small Maoist guerrilla group in the remote eastern mountains, villagers said on Wednesday.

They said Cuneyt Kahraman, head of the Turkish Workers and Peasants Liberation Army (TIKKO), was among seven people killed in a clash with security forces in the rugged province of Tunceli last weekend.

Security officials were not immediately availiable for comment. Villagers contacted by telephone by Reuters said Kahraman was heavily wounded in a clash near his home village of Tekeli and died shortly after through loss of blood.
Kahraman, in his late 20s, took over leadership of the Maoist group last year after the then leader was killed by fellow rebels for suspected collaboration with state forces.

TIKKO has been active in Tunceli since the 1970s but its attacks have been limited in recent years. The group is estimated to have about 100 armed members in the province, also scene of fighting between troops and Kurdish separatist rebels.
